title: Orchestration control (OC)
subtitle: Configure the governed request pipeline and the single egress gateway.
loadFailed: Could not load the OC configuration
stale: The configuration was changed by someone else. Refresh and try again.
pending: An OC change is awaiting approval.
leaveBody: You have unsaved OC changes that will be lost.
publishFirst: Publish the agent first, then submit OC changes.
noChanges: The OC draft matches the live version.
approvalRequired: Approval required: once approved it goes live as a new agent version containing only the OC changes. If rejected the draft is kept.
approvalOff: No approval flow is configured: it takes effect immediately and contains only the OC changes.
replaceBody: An OC change is already pending. Withdraw it and submit the current draft?
pipelineSubtitle: Every message goes through this governed path.
denied: You do not have permission to view orchestration.
draftDiffers: The OC draft differs from the live version and has not been submitted.
inSync: The OC draft matches the live version.

glossary.hint: The agent glossary adjusts the platform industry and tenant glossaries. At runtime, aliases expand the search query and the definitions of matched terms go into the prompt.
glossary.useTenantHint: When off, only this agent's own terms are used.
glossary.hiddenCount: {{count}} inherited terms removed for this agent
glossary.inheritedNotice: This term is inherited. Saving makes it an override for this agent; upper layers are unchanged.
glossary.hideBody: “{{name}}” will be hidden for this agent; upper layers are unaffected. Use “Restore all” to bring it back.

rewrite.hint: Rewriting is used for routing and retrieval only; the conversation keeps the user's original text. If it times out (1.5 s) or fails, the original question is used.
rewrite.enableHint: When off, the original question goes straight to routing; alias expansion is unaffected.
rewrite.modelHint: Only chat models enabled for this tenant can be chosen.
rewrite.lowConfidence: Only rewrite when intent confidence is low
rewrite.lowConfidenceHint: Routing decides by confidence; when off, every question is rewritten.
rewrite.coreferenceHint: Replace “it / this” with the object from earlier turns.
rewrite.normalizeHint: Turn casual wording into standard phrasing.
rewrite.decomposeHint: Split several questions in one sentence and retrieve each.
rewrite.translateHint: Translate the question into a target language before retrieval.
rewrite.customHint: Appended to the rewrite instructions, up to 2000 characters.
rewrite.testHint: Try a question with the current unsaved settings. Only changed steps are shown; this makes one debug call.
rewrite.testPlaceholder: e.g. How do I return this SKU?

failure.timeout: Rewrite timed out; the original question was used.
failure.error: The rewrite call failed; the original question was used.
failure.invalid: The rewrite result could not be parsed; the original question was used.

routing.hint: Intent judgement decides whether a capability answers a message directly (path A) or the agent plans it (path B). A failed judgement, low confidence or a write always goes to the agent.
routing.enableHint: When off, the agent decides on its own whether to call capabilities. {{count}} capabilities are in scope.
routing.modelHint: Only chat models enabled for this tenant; a fast classification model is recommended.
routing.thresholdHint: Below this top confidence the agent decides.
routing.marginHint: When the top two are too close the agent decides.
routing.faqDirectHint: Return the answer when a knowledge base has a sufficiently certain FAQ match.
routing.customHint: Appended to the classifier prompt to add business wording.

rules.title: Priority rules
rules.enableHint: A message that hits a rule skips the model and calls the target directly. Smaller numbers match first.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.priorityHint: Smaller matches first; ties go to the older rule.
rules.keywordHint: Separate keywords with commas or new lines; any one hits.
rules.testQuestion: Type a sentence to test the rule

memory.hint: Short-term memory is the context in the conversation window; long-term memory is extracted after a conversation ends, kept per end user, redacted before it is stored, and can be deleted per user at any time.

tier.short: Your plan (Standard) has short-term memory only; long-term memory needs Professional or above.
tier.short_long: Your plan (Professional) includes long-term memory; the user profile belongs to a single agent.
tier.all_cross_assistant: Your plan (Enterprise) includes long-term memory and a user profile shared across agents.

short.title: Short-term memory
short.enableHint: When off, every message goes without the earlier conversation.
short.tokensHint: When exceeded the oldest messages are dropped first; the newest is always kept. Tokens are estimated.

type.factHint: Temporary facts that go stale quickly

long.title: Long-term memory
long.enableHint: When off nothing is written or injected.
long.locked: Your plan has no long-term memory; these settings are saved but have no effect.

file.profilePrivate: On this plan the profile is not shared across agents

user_profile.name: User profile
user_profile.source: Identity, role and industry mentioned in conversations
user_profile.access: Written by the system; employees can view and delete it
user_profile.help: Form of address, role, industry — no contact details.

user_memory.name: User memory
user_memory.source: Preferences and history extracted from conversations
user_memory.access: Written by the system; employees can switch it off or delete it
user_memory.help: Stable preferences and behaviour. New items are compared with what is already stored: repeats are not written twice and newer statements replace older ones.

tools.name: Tools
tools.source: Tool call records (tool name and count only)
tools.access: Recorded by the system, never arguments or results
tools.help: Which tools the user used — name and count only.

session.name: Session summaries
session.source: A summary when the conversation ends
session.access: Written by the system; cleared when it expires
session.help: One or two sentences per conversation.

classes.title: Memory classes and policy
classes.hint: Scope, source, who reads and writes, and retention of each class.
classes.privacy: Sensitive data (phone numbers, e-mail addresses…) is always redacted before it is stored; nothing is written once the administrator or the employee switches personal memory off; everything of one end user can be deleted at once.

dialog.title: Configure {{name}}
dialog.topKHint: The most items one answer brings in, ranked by relevance and recency.
dialog.retentionHint: 1–3650 days, cleared when it expires; mentioning it again restarts the clock.
dialog.writeHint: When off the profile is no longer extracted.
dialog.subscribeHint: When off the profile stays out of the answer's context.

components.hint: Injects the channel's published components into the system prompt, validates the model's JSON and falls back per the channel's compatibility matrix.
components.enableHint: When off, no component is injected and the agent replies in plain text.
components.maxHint: 1–5; values outside the range are pulled in.
components.templateHint: Used when a channel shows components as text. Variables: {{title}} {{fields}}
components.previewHint: Read-only, from each channel's published snapshot; to change it, edit the channel and publish again.
components.noChannels: No channel is bound to this agent yet.
components.notPublished: Not published yet; nothing is injected.
components.nothingInjected: Published, but there is nothing to inject (or component orchestration is off).
